name: Fried Drop Cakes
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Beat egg until light; add milk, dry ingredients mixed and sifted, and melted butter.
Drop by spoonfuls in hot, new, deep fat; fry until light brown and cooked through, which must at first be determined by piercing with a skewer, or breaking apart.
Remove with a skimmer, and drain on brown paper.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
